provenance: Reports are verbatim reflector output already produced by the V1 calibration and the V2 untreated arm. No report was written, edited or regenerated for this experiment.
purpose: Frozen craft reports, selected before any repeated grading, for measuring grader repeatability on identical report bytes.
selection_rule: One report per outcome class, plus both sides of each instance whose judgement changed between V1 and the byte-identical V2 untreated rerun. Chosen for semantic shape and known prior grade, never for observed instability under repetition — no repeated grading had been run.
